plainTranslation: Their confidence, encouragement, and appetite for possibility press against your direction, ambitions, and public reputation.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
summaryShort: Their confidence, encouragement, and appetite for possibility press against your direction, ambitions, and public reputation.
summaryDeep: Their confidence, encouragement, and appetite for possibility press against your direction, ambitions, and public reputation. It catches often enough that you both feel it, and it keeps asking to be worked out. Name it directly instead of letting it build in silence.
